high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "blessedarch," who has verified status. The post was made 14 hours prior to the screenshot being taken at 2:29 PM, as indicated by the timestamp in the top left corner. The post features a black-and-white illustration of a concept from 1936 for making the Eiffel Tower accessible by car. The illustration shows a detailed design where a road or bridge structure is built around the base of the Eiffel Tower, allowing vehicles to drive up to the tower's base. The surrounding area includes urban buildings, green spaces
